name: 77015 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77015 (Houston) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77015 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 23 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
